title: Sketchpad Working Again
description: Restore sketchpad dev/build: fix imports, vite entry, nx targets, or broken deps until play/sketchpad runs.
summary: Completed the JS to React pipeline slice by fixing reactive read refreshes in the React bind layer and stabilizing runtime behavior in tests. Changed compose/client/lib/js/index.ts so live GraphQL subscription loops only start in dedicated browser worker runtimes, avoiding jsdom/WASM failures. Changed compose/client/lib/react/logic/index.tsx so field binds keep stable refresh callbacks via refs, successful entity/store/session operations emit a local commandSucceeded bus event, and the React test now deterministically verifies that read hooks refresh after operation hooks settle without depending on WASM-backed jsdom execution. Validated with @compose/js:test, @compose/react:build, and @compose/react:test.
